title: Diet, Exercise and Lifestyle
seo_title: Year 6 Science: Diet, Exercise and Lifestyle Worksheets (Nutrients and Food Labels)
standard_text: Recognise the impact of diet, exercise, drugs and lifestyle on the way their bodies function.
meta_desc: Free Year 6 science worksheets on diet, exercise and lifestyle: nutrients, the Eatwell Guide, traffic-light food labels, sugar in drinks, activity, smoking, alcohol and medicines. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: What we eat and do changes our bodies.
key_sub: Balance nutrients, stay active, and avoid harmful drugs.
body_html:
How to think about it

Diet, exercise and lifestyle choices change how well the body works.

  • Nutrients: carbohydrates (energy), protein (growth and repair), fats (stored energy), vitamins and minerals (health), fibre (digestion) and water.
  • The Eatwell Guide: about a third fruit and vegetables, about a third starchy foods, smaller amounts of protein, dairy, and oils.
  • Exercise strengthens the heart and muscles. Smoking, alcohol and misusing drugs harm organs; medicines must be used as directed.
Example

A drink has 28 g of sugar. Teaspoons (4 g each)?

28 ÷ 4

Answer: 7 teaspoons

Example

Cereal: 25 g sugar per 100 g. Label colour?

More than 22.5 g is high

Answer: high (red)

Common mistakes

  • Thinking fat has no job in the body.
  • Thinking medicines are safe in any amount.
  • Reading per 100 g as the amount in the whole packet.

faq.a: Carbohydrates for energy, protein for growth and repair, fats for stored energy, vitamins and minerals for health, plus fibre and water.
They show whether a food is low (green), medium (amber) or high (red) in fat, saturated fat, sugar and salt per 100 g, so you can compare foods.

faq.q: How does lifestyle affect the body?
faq.a: Exercise and good sleep help the heart and brain. Smoking damages the lungs and heart, and too much alcohol damages the liver.
